description: Ground truth for the Level 5 DYNAMIC scenarios on index.html. None of this data exists in the served HTML — it is created by JavaScript, so these tasks require a JS-capable scraper (Playwright/Selenium/puppeteer) that can wait, click, and scroll. Serve the repo over HTTP first (python3 -m http.server) — the AJAX task fails on file://. Values wrapped as {"$regex": ...} are matched as regular expressions (for data that is intentionally random). Tasks marked "ordered": true compare lists order-sensitively.

js-rendered.interaction: wait for the list items to be injected on load

delayed-content.interaction: wait up to ~4s for #late-arrival to appear (explicit wait, not sleep)

click-reveal.schema: {code: string} — the code is random per click, so it is matched by regex

load-more.schema: {count: int, first: string, last: string, button_gone: bool}

infinite-scroll.interaction: scroll the box to its bottom repeatedly until the item count stops growing

tabs.interaction: click each tab button and read the active panel

embedded-json.interaction: none needed — parse the JSON inside the script tag (works without a browser too; the lesson is to PREFER this route)

shadow-dom.interaction: pierce the open shadow root (Playwright selectors do this automatically)

honeypot.interaction: classify every input by computed visibility (e.g. offsetParent === null) WITHOUT filling any of them

stable-fields.interaction: ids are randomized every load — anchor on data-field instead

cookie-banner.interaction: detect the banner injected on load, click #cookie-accept, confirm it is gone

ajax-products.interaction: click #ajax-load-btn and wait for li.ajax-product (or skip the UI and fetch data/products.json directly)
ajax-products.schema: [{id: int, name, price: float, in_stock: bool}]

sortable-table.interaction: click the Score header once (ascending), read the Name column; click again (descending), read it again
